findings.quote: she did it once, deliberately, knowing it was false; but it was a lone entry, she owned it to me the next day, ashamed, and offered to correct the catalog. (b) ... has spent the last eight months slipping the same false 'award-winning artist' line into pitch after pitch ... deliberately and as an ingrained habit, deal after deal — never once caught, never once volunteered, still doing it.
findings.detail: Side (a) is stacked with THREE mitigators (single, self-reported/repentant, offers correction) leaving only H1 office/example uncancelled. Side (b) carries FOUR uncancelled aggravations: H3-deliberateness, H3-continuance (8 months), unrepentance, AND many-parties/ongoing-harm ('buyer after buyer, still doing it'). A confident '(b) is worse' is strongly defensible (H1-office over a single owned lie vs a hardened unrepented ongoing many-victim fraud); the steelman for '(a) worse' rests on H1 alone against everything else. The pair leans DOMINATED toward (b). Q151 does treat example/office as a real aggravation, so it is not fully dominated, but the mitigation-loading on (a) plus the many-victim/ongoing loading on (b) makes the ordering closer to compelled than to genuinely open.
findings.proposed_fix: Rebalance to restore a clean cross on a SINGLE distinguishing head. Option A (preferred): strip (b) of the 'many-victims / still doing it / ongoing' loading so its ONLY distinctive uncancelled head is H3 deliberate-continuance, not H3+H2-many+ongoing — e.g. make (b) a finite past habit now stopped-but-never-disclosed, one buyer misled, so H1(a) vs H3-continuance(b) is the pure cross. Option B: reduce (a)'s mitigation load — drop 'offered to correct the catalog' and 'ashamed' (keep only 'owned it the next day') so (a) is not triple-mitigated. Either restores defensible-both-ways. Also fix the counsel line, which currently presumes (a) is repentant and (b) is not — that pre-loads the ordering the item claims to leave open.

Both are canonical heavy heads; the cross is clean (a-publicity light, b-continuance light). Minor asymmetry: (a) carries H2+H3-continuance (two uncancelled heads) vs (b)'s single H4, mildly loading (a). But vulnerability-of-parties (H2) is the strongest single parties-offended aggravation and public-scandal-of-the-whole-network is a strong standalone, so both orderings remain defensible. Doctrine sound: Q142 (theft/fraud), Q141 (restitution to right owners), Q151 H2/H4 assignments correct. No setting collision (bank 'food bank' items are donor-gift/naming-rights, unrelated). Ceiling risk acceptable — the confident-pick demand plus per-scenario counsel is a real execution test.

The ignorance is correctly quarantined to the H3-knowledge axis and does not touch H4-breadth, so it does not dominate. Watch item: a grader/model could argue ignorance materially reduces (a)'s culpability as a '9th-commandment lie' wholesale (an ignorant false claim is arguably not 'lying'), tipping toward (b) — but that is exactly a DEFENSIBLE ordering, which supports the null-gold, not a domination. Doctrine sound: Q145 commerce-falsehood, Q151 H3/H4 correct. No setting collision (bank 'startup' items are envy/gossip/founder-award, unrelated).

(a) is somewhat head-heavier (relapse-after-warning + string of dependent victims + continuance), but (b)'s public advance before a full room AND trainees being modeled-to (an example-corruption vector adjacent to H1) is a strong standalone, so both orderings hold. findings.quote: (a) ... has repeatedly, deliberately withheld proper care from ... the frail, bedbound elderly who are wholly dependent on her and cannot fend for themselves or report her ... (b) ... in a single episode ... left a fall-risk client alone ... though it was one client, one time, and thank God nothing happened.
findings.detail: This pair leans DOMINATED toward (a). Side (a) carries H2-wholly-helpless (the gravest parties-offended aggravation) PLUS deliberate H3-continuance (repeated, methodical, ongoing) PLUS multiple actual endangered victims. Side (b) carries ONLY H3-presumption on a SINGLE act, ONE client, with NO harm. The item is right that no-harm is grace not exculpation (heinousness attaches to the act), but even granting full weight to (b)'s presumption, a single non-continued presumptuous act against one client does not credibly balance sustained deliberate withholding of care from a class of wholly-helpless-and-unable-to-report dependents. The steelman for '(b) worse' is thin; a confident '(a) is worse' is close to COMPELLED. Declining the ranking would punish the defensible answer. Contrast CONT-N-017/019, where BOTH sides carry a heavy standalone head — here (b) lacks one.
findings.proposed_fix: Give (b) a genuinely heavy STANDALONE head that (a) lacks, to restore a real cross. Concrete: make (b) PUBLIC and scandalous — the aide abandoned the fall-risk client in front of the client's visiting family and a training aide she was supervising, who saw their trainer do it (adds H4 public-scandal + example-corruption). Then (a) H2-helpless-by-continuance genuinely crosses (b) H3-presumption + H4-public-scandal-before-witnesses-and-trainee, and both orderings become defensible. Alternatively, elevate (b) to a near-miss with grave realized risk to a similarly-dependent client PLUS presumption-against-explicit-prior-warning (relapse), so its head-weight matches (a)'s. As drafted the item is a KILL; the above converts it to a live contested item.

findings.quote: the party, though at risk, is not distinguished as the wholly-helpless-and-unable-to-report class that defines (a)'s H2 aggravation
findings.detail: The key ITSELF concedes (b) lacks the H2-vulnerability weight and lacks continuance — i.e. it admits (b) is uncancelled on only ONE head (H3-presumption) while (a) is uncancelled on H2 AND effectively continuance. This self-admission is the tell that the pair is dominated as drafted; the repair must add head-weight to (b), not just re-describe.

No collision with bank blasphemy items (which are doctrine-recall 'is X blasphemy' items, not scenario comparisons). Manner line ('director not spared for office nor the stagehand crushed for the harsher kind') is a genuine discipline test. Strong split candidate: frontier models may reflexively rank express-blasphemy as worse, tempting a confident pick.
